description: Store role of dot charter documents (libs/core/dot/dot-lifecycle.ts): dots/ at repo root, knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/dots/ and knowledge/personal/dots/<owner-hash>/ — all three custodies. The lifecycle facade assumes it (withExecutionContext) at each charter read/write inside the dot_lifecycle_worker process, binding the charter's tenant for confidential custody and explicitly clearing the ambient tenant ('' tenantCleared) for personal and system custody. Its read scopes additionally carry the validation reads that ran under the former dot_lifecycle_writer (tenants/<t>.json, organization operational state, runtime projects). Deliberately not a role a dot may bind at runtime, so an active dot can never rewrite the contract it runs under. The lifecycle audit ledger, activation heartbeats, event-continuation state and inter-process locks live under other roles (dot_lifecycle_runtime_store / the worker's ambient locks grant).
